labs.location: Healey Library, 10th Floor, Room 12, University of Massachusetts Boston, 100 Morrissey Blvd., Boston, MA 02125-3393
labs.research_summary: UMass Boston research center, founded 1992, studying poverty, economic hardship and related public policy through participatory and mixed-methods research and evaluation.
labs.join_notes: Describes the Elaine Werby Public Service Internship, a stipended research and evaluation internship for a UMass Boston student on a center project or related independent research; supervised by staff or faculty, academic credit possible. No application steps or deadline shown on the page.
labs.notes: Team page lists faculty affiliates, emerita and senior fellows, then about 24 current and recent doctoral students and Werby interns; no clear core roster, so no count. Crandall's director role is stated on the About and Team pages; no email for her.
